cookiesIntro: To make Seeagle work properly, we install small files called cookies on your device.
cookieDefinition: A cookie is a small text file that a website stores on your device when you visit said site.
firstPartyCookies: First party cookies are cookies set by the website and only it can read them. Moreover, a website might use external services, which use third-party cookies
persistentCookies: Persistent cookies, which are saved on your computer and are not deleted automatically when you quit your browser.
essentialCookiesNote: Every time you enter our website, essential cookies for the functionality of the website will be activated automatically.
cookiesPurpose: Their purpose is to remember settings and preferences such as language, account login etc. for a period of time.
cookiesUsageIntro: We only use essential cookies, necessary for keeping you logged in for a longer period of time and other settings. We do not use any marketing or analytics cookies.
cookiesUsageListTitle: This is what we use cookies for:
cookiesUsageItem3: Keeping you logged in for a limited, longer period of time
